# Manage a customer renewal or expansion

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

Before a customer contract reaches its renewal or expansion decision point. An authorized renewal, changed agreement or planned non-renewal reconciled with service and billing.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

> This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Establish the contract timeline and evidence

agent-runnable


Gather the signed terms, renewal and notice provisions, current usage, support issues and value delivered. Confirm the customer contacts and flag dates that need contract-owner review.

- Sources: [GitLab retain and expand operating procedures](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/sales/sales-operating-procedures/retain-and-expand/)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Review outcomes and future needs with the customer

human · human approval required


Discuss actual results, unresolved concerns and the customer's next priorities. Distinguish an agreed need from a sales assumption and identify delivery or security changes requiring review.

- Sources: [GitLab retain and expand operating procedures](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/sales/sales-operating-procedures/retain-and-expand/)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Prepare renewal and expansion alternatives

agent-runnable


Model the proposed scope, price, implementation and support implications against approved commercial policy. Show the effects of a smaller renewal or exit as well as an expansion.

- Sources: [GitLab retain and expand operating procedures](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/sales/sales-operating-procedures/retain-and-expand/)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Approve and finalize the chosen terms

human · human approval required


Authorized parties review and execute the final agreement or renewal action. Keep unapproved discounts, custom commitments and notice decisions out of informal correspondence.

- Sources: [GitLab retain and expand operating procedures](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/sales/sales-operating-procedures/retain-and-expand/)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Reconcile the agreement with delivery and billing

agent-runnable


Verify product entitlements, invoice dates and account ownership against the final decision. Assign onboarding for new scope or orderly offboarding for a non-renewal and retain the evidence.

- Verify: An authorized renewal, changed agreement or planned non-renewal reconciled with service and billing.
- Sources: [GitLab retain and expand operating procedures](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/sales/sales-operating-procedures/retain-and-expand/)
